item.title: An Avatar (The Nickelodeon animation ) Tactics or RPG?
item.author: invalid@example.com (Manta_Breh)
item.dc:creator: Manta_Breh
item.content:encoded: Yes an Avatar game based on the Nickelodeon animation ... I've always wanted a game based on this universe that's not a fighting game (because I suck at it and it just seems like a cop-out lol). My choice is for a party based RPG as I feel like there's so much potential with it and all sorts of role playing aspects that you can do such as benevolent avatar or someone that's more cold and towards the greater good. A dream game would be something akin to Mass Effect or more like BG3/Rogue Trader.
